title: Just the database bits
hints: README → New syntax: `sed -n` with a `/START/,/END/` range and `p`.
The section runs from the `[database]` line to the next empty line; inside it, print only lines with at least one character.
`sed -n '/^\[database\]/,/^$/{...}' "$DATA/services.conf"`: inside the braces, print lines matching `/./`.
